findings.title: StaticForms accessKey exposed in client-side HTML
findings.description: The StaticForms API access key (sf_06193e9224b406b37979ed81) is embedded as a hidden input in the form HTML rendered by main.js. Any visitor can extract it from the DOM and submit directly to api.staticforms.xyz/submit, bypassing all server-side validation in the Cloudflare Worker (honeypot, required fields, LGPD consent, rate limiting).
findings.impact: Attacker can send unlimited spam/phishing to the Vizier contact inbox, bypassing all Worker validation. No client data exposure but channel integrity compromised.
findings.attack_scenario: 1. Open site, inspect DOM for accessKey hidden input. 2. POST to https://api.staticforms.xyz/submit with extracted key + arbitrary fields. 3. Email delivered to Vizier inbox without LGPD consent or honeypot.
findings.fix_description: Removed accessKey from client-side HTML. Added STATICFORMS_ACCESS_KEY env var in wrangler.jsonc. Worker now injects accessKey server-side via env.STATICFORMS_ACCESS_KEY.

findings.title: PII leakage in Worker console.log (LGPD violation)
findings.description: Worker logs all form field values (name, email, phone, CNPJ, message) to console via console.log. These logs are visible in wrangler tail and the Cloudflare dashboard, constituting processing of personal data without explicit consent for logging as a processing purpose under LGPD art. 7.
findings.impact: Anyone with Cloudflare dashboard access can read client PII in logs. Regulatory risk under LGPD. Trust risk if logs are subpoenaed or leaked.
findings.attack_scenario: Operator with wrangler tail access reads submitted form data including names, emails, phone numbers from logs. No technical exploit needed — data is plaintext in logs.
findings.fix_description: Replaced PII logging with metadata-only logging (field count). Error path now truncates response text to 100 chars.

findings.title: No rate limiting on form submission endpoint
findings.description: The Worker has no rate limiting. An attacker can send hundreds of POST requests in sequence, exhausting the Cloudflare Workers free quota (100k req/day) and flooding the contact inbox.
findings.impact: Light DoS via quota exhaustion. Inbox spam. Cloudflare edge DDoS protection does not cover low-volume endpoint abuse.
findings.attack_scenario: Script sends 1000 POST /api/submit requests. Worker processes each, consuming CPU time. StaticForms delivers 1000 emails to Vizier inbox. Quota consumed.
findings.fix_description: Added in-memory rate limiter (Map keyed by CF-Connecting-IP): 10 requests per 60s. HTTP 429 on excess. Periodic cleanup via setInterval.

hardening_notes.title: CSP allows unused external origins
hardening_notes.description: script-src includes www.google.com, www.gstatic.com but no scripts from these origins are loaded. connect-src included formspree.io but the service used is StaticForms. Removed formspree.io from CSP as part of this audit.

hardening_notes.title: unsafe-inline in CSP scripts
hardening_notes.description: Required for legitimate inline scripts (JSON-LD, mobile guardian). No user-generated content exists, so XSS is not currently exploitable. If UGC is added, replace with nonces/hashes.

hardening_notes.title: CORS preflight returns wildcard origin
hardening_notes.description: OPTIONS handler returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. POST does not set CORS headers. Cross-origin JS cannot read the response, but server-side POST executes. Low risk given no authentication.

coverage_note: Single run. Additional runs recommended to catch findings this run may have missed.
